parsed.post: Significant improvement: increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 dropped val_bpb from 1.1057 to 1.0420. The model scales better with depth despite the fixed 5-min budget. Next, I'll try to fine-tune the learning rate to see if we can stabilize this higher depth.
parsed.description: Increasing depth to 6 and slightly lowering learning rate to 0.06 to ensure stability at higher depth.
